title: Zenko Configuration Schema
description: Configuration schema for Zenko OpenAPI code generation

types.description: Global type generation configuration applied to all schemas unless overridden per-schema

schemas.description: Array of OpenAPI schemas to generate TypeScript from

TypesConfig.description: Controls how helper types are generated and imported

emit.description: Whether to generate operation type definitions and helper type imports

helpers.description: How to provide helper types: 'package' (import from zenko), 'inline' (write definitions in generated file), or 'file' (import from custom file)

helpersOutput.description: Path for helper types file when helpers='file'. Can be relative to output file or absolute. Automatically generated.

treeShake.description: Whether to tree-shake unused types. When true, only types that are used in the operations will be generated.

optionalType.description: How to handle optional fields: 'optional' (z.optional() - field can be undefined), 'nullable' (z.nullable() - field can be null), or 'nullish' (z.nullish() - field can be undefined or null)

input.description: Path to OpenAPI specification file (YAML or JSON). Relative to config file directory.

output.description: Path for generated TypeScript output file. Relative to config file directory.

strictDates.description: Enable strict ISO 8601 date/time format validation in Zod schemas. Overrides global setting.

strictNumeric.description: Enable numeric constraint validation (min/max, string length, patterns). Overrides global setting.

types.description: Per-schema type generation configuration. Overrides global types config.

operationIds.description: Array of operation IDs to include in the generated file. If not provided, all operations will be included.

oneOf.description: Object form allows customizing the prefix for unknown enum values. 'open' controls which enums are open (boolean or array of enum names). 'unknownPrefix' sets the prefix for unknown values (default: 'Unknown:').

openEnums.description: Make enums 'open' to accept unknown string values. If true, all enums are open. If array, only named enums in the list are open. If object, use 'open' to specify which enums are open and 'unknownPrefix' to customize the prefix. Unknown values are transformed to template literals like `${prefix}${value}`.
